budget_compatibility.small_counterexample: Five owners and one disjoint nonempty interval complete at 22 legacy units; eight fused setup units followed by a sixteen-unit lookup fail at the same boundary. Regression test fixes this boundary.
budget_compatibility.lazy_reuse: Overlap runs first against the exact immutable owners captured by the index. Containment retains every original lookup and owner-inspection reservation, in the original order, even when the negative overlap disproves nonempty containment. Empty anchors use the original predicate.
budget_compatibility.exhaustive_small_test: Dense/sparse populations, duplicates, adjacent and empty owners, mixed intervals, invalid blocks, and each budget 0..160 preserve both result and remaining allowance.
budget_compatibility.limitation: Keeping the original shared-budget trajectory cannot itself fund the remaining Controller proof publication. No CPU speedup claim.

late_evidence.scope: Only newly source-closed, whole single-component records under MandatoryInitialComponentBoundary, established/complete/reason-free with an established complete parent.
late_evidence.ordering: Runs after every existing proof, ownership, diagnostic and deferred-domain consumer. Never edits earlier records, candidates, partitions or diagnostics.
guards: Whole-component exact source frame and original 512-token parent bound
Original scalar-only literal multiset constructor and independent source verification
No alternative-line-break normalization, orphan or incomplete context
Deduplicate complete old/new single-component physical scopes, including prior receipts with another relation id or an inert inter-block separator tag
Pay source reconstruction, scope checks, copies, verification, retention and output; preserve 6 GB/swap0 and all prior caps
Existing output-stop veto forbids optional late receipts
late_evidence.ownership: Adds non-owning evidence only. Does not localize ambiguous edits, increase coverage, or turn unresolved comparisons into successes.
tests: Real guarded closure preserves all previous records, ownership and diagnostics
Zero or insufficient budget cannot publish a partial receipt
New relation id cannot duplicate an existing full physical scope
Every consumed late-work unit is included in evidence-link accounting

cpu_causality: Unresolved. Earlier single-thread ABBA did not reproduce the parallel-run slowdown; this is not causal attribution or a full-panel speedup estimate.
